name: Generalized Polynomial Chaos Expansion (gPCE)
summary: Approximate random physical model outputs using orthogonal polynomial functions of uncertain input variables.
summary_zh: 以输入随机变量的正交多项式展开近似模型输出，传播参数不确定性。
core_idea: Project stochastic responses on distribution-adapted polynomial bases, often with Galerkin or nonintrusive fitting.
innovation: Can efficiently approximate uncertainty propagation for relatively low-dimensional smooth stochastic inputs.
limitations: High input dimension or nonsmooth dependence degrades efficiency.
Polynomial truncation and quadrature require accuracy checks.

start_here.why: Generalized polynomial-chaos formulation with stochastic differential equation examples.
start_here.focus: Orthogonal bases, spectral projection and convergence limits.

curation_note: Authoritative journal source checked; the proposed starting reference is optional.
